_: Draft cards. One pick per stage cleared, 3 offered. See docs/05-powers.md for the calibration method. `gain` is an ESTIMATED percentage of per-stage capability against the measured floor baseline (~158 pts/stage); these are the numbers the simulation must confirm, not numbers it has confirmed.
_calibration: Targets grow 25% per stage and the player gets exactly one pick per stage, so the average pick must be worth slightly LESS than 25% or the ladder becomes infinite. Target: commons 8-15%, uncommons 15-25%, rares 25-35%.

offer._weights: Rarity weights by stage cleared, as common/uncommon/rare.
